All code-related outputs must be completed and implemented according to any specifications in the corresponding GitHub issues or tickets.

ms.report:
gOuroboros: Milestone 1: complete
The Tx submission has been implemented and client support and tests have been established as specified in their corresponding tickets. This is evidenced by the code output, automated testing where applicable, and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 1 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/8/views/2, where Milestone 1 issues can be found and their specifications and code, linked pull requests within each issue, can be examined. All Milestone 1 tickets have been completed and closed. Corresponding usage documentation has been added and can be found here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/gouroboros
